findings.message: The claim 'One sound changes' (Hindi 'एक ध्वनि बदलती है') is not exactly right. In the readings यक्ष (ya-k-ṣa) and यज्ञ (ya-j-ña), two consonants differ (k→j and ṣ→ñ). All the other claims in a1 have support. This is minor, so a human should decide whether to reword it.
findings.suggested_fix: EN: 'One cluster of sounds changes (kṣa becomes jña), and the picture moves…'; HI: 'बस एक संयुक्ताक्षर बदलता है (क्ष की जगह ज्ञ), और चित्र…'
